label: Nemetona system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Nemetona locus represented by a VCA0441 profile that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Nemetona branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VCA0441 genes, VCA0441 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Nemetona locus, unresolved Nemetona trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
